benchmark: TrafficSignNet ZCU104 VART C++ comprehensive suite

metadata.uname: Linux xilinx-zcu104-20222 5.15.36-xilinx-v2022.2 #1 SMP Mon Oct 3 07:50:07 UTC 2022 aarch64 aarch64 aarch64 GNU/Linux
metadata.power_sensor_scope: Linux hwmon power channel exposed by the board image; not automatically claimed as wall-plug or FPGA-fabric-only power
metadata.preprocess: OpenCV BGR->RGB, INTER_AREA resize to model input, uint8->INT8 LUT implementing round((pixel/255)*2^fix_point)

single_stream_model_only.description: Synchronous batch-1 VART/DPU execution with an already quantized INT8 input resident in the runner input buffer.
single_stream_model_only.purpose: Primary latency benchmark and fair model-runtime reference for batch-1 comparisons.
caveats: One request is in flight at a time; this is latency-oriented, not maximum two-DPU-core throughput.

single_stream_host_to_host.description: Synchronous batch-1 application-compute path starting from a decoded/resized RGB uint8 image in host RAM.
single_stream_host_to_host.purpose: Measures host preprocessing overhead plus one DPU inference and class decision.
caveats: Uses an optimized 256-entry LUT that is mathematically equivalent to round((pixel/255)*2^input_fix_point).

fixed_workload_memory_single_stream.description: Closed workload of different real dataset images already decoded/resized and resident in RAM, processed serially at batch 1.
fixed_workload_memory_single_stream.purpose: Answers: if N real images are already in memory, how long until the Nth result is complete on a single synchronous stream?
caveats: Total elapsed time is measured directly from the first image start to completion of the last image; FPS is images/that wall time.

fixed_workload_end_to_end_single_stream.description: Closed workload of different real image files processed serially from filesystem path to predicted class.
fixed_workload_end_to_end_single_stream.purpose: Closest local-file measurement to 'I gave the application N image files; when was the last result ready?'.
caveats: OS page cache is not flushed between repetitions, so later runs can benefit from cached file data.

full_dataset_end_to_end.description: Serial end-to-end pass over every labeled image file currently present under the dataset directory.
full_dataset_end_to_end.purpose: Measures accuracy plus complete file-to-prediction throughput on the available board dataset.
caveats: The repository deployment subset contains fewer images than the official 12,630-image GTSRB test set unless you replace/copy the full test directory to the board.

worker_sweep_model_only.description: Concurrent VART runner/worker sweep using 1..N independent Runner instances and prequantized batch-1 input.
worker_sweep_model_only.purpose: Finds the worker count that best keeps multiple DPU cores occupied for maximum DPU/VART throughput.
caveats: Each runner has private input/output buffers; runner creation and warmup are outside the timed region.
More workers than physical DPU cores can still be useful to hide scheduling/host gaps, but can also reduce performance.

worker_sweep_host_to_host.description: Concurrent host-to-host sweep using 1..N independent Runner instances; every inference performs LUT quantization and argmax.
worker_sweep_host_to_host.purpose: Finds the worker count that maximizes application-compute throughput while including host preprocessing.
caveats: Each runner has private input/output buffers; runner creation and warmup are outside the timed region.
More workers than physical DPU cores can still be useful to hide scheduling/host gaps, but can also reduce performance.

max_throughput_model_only.description: Long sustained confirmation using the worker count selected by the model-only sweep.
max_throughput_model_only.purpose: Reports the maximum sustained VART/DPU throughput configuration discovered by the suite.
caveats: This is a throughput-capacity result and must not replace the single-stream batch-1 latency result.

max_throughput_host_to_host.description: Long sustained confirmation using the worker count selected by the host-to-host sweep.
max_throughput_host_to_host.purpose: Reports maximum sustained application-compute throughput with optimized INT8 preprocessing.
caveats: This is a maximum-throughput result, not single-request latency.

fixed_workload_memory_parallel.description: Closed in-memory workload processed concurrently by the best host-to-host worker count discovered in the sweep.
fixed_workload_memory_parallel.purpose: Answers: with both DPU cores/available runtime concurrency exploited, how long until all N in-memory real images are classified?
caveats: Total completion wall time is the key metric; individual per-request latencies can increase while total workload completion time decreases.

full_dataset_end_to_end_worker_sweep.description: Complete file-to-classification pass over every labeled test image using 1..N independent VART runners/threads.
full_dataset_end_to_end_worker_sweep.purpose: Primary real-workload capacity benchmark: answers how long a complete image set takes when host I/O, decode, resize, quantization and all available DPU concurrency are used.
caveats: The official GTSRB test split contains 12,630 images across 43 classes; if fewer files are present, the report marks the dataset incomplete.
OS page cache is not forcibly flushed, so repeated runs may benefit from caching.
Use this section for real batch-of-files completion time and maximum end-to-end throughput; do not use it as single-request latency.

cold_start.description: Fresh Linux process startup through completion of the first classification.
cold_start.purpose: Measures startup cost separately from steady-state inference.
caveats: The parent measures child process wall-clock duration; this intentionally includes more than inference.
